chunks: The Day when the earth will be replaced by other than the earth, and the heavens [will be so], and they will appear before Allah, the One, the All-Powerful.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the earth and heavens on the Day of Judgment according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah as 'Al-Qahhar' (The Subduer), emphasizing that the cosmic restructuring is not merely physical but a manifestation of divine justice. The transformation signifies the removal of worldly illusions, allowing creation to stand before the One God for a direct reckoning, a theme resonating with the concept of *Barzakh* and the ultimate return to the Divine Source.
